what_it_does: Modern wireless devices need to transmit data across multiple frequency bands (low-band and high-band sub-6 GHz signals) without violating strict emission regulations. The problem is that digital-to-analog conversion at high sampling rates creates unwanted signal copies at certain frequencies that interfere with the legitimate transmission. Traditional solutions need expensive off-chip filters or separate transmitter chains for each band. This paper proposes a unified transmitter using a clever combination of digital filtering and analog circuit tricks. The digital stage reduces the required sampling rate intelligently, and the analog power amplifier integrates filtering directly into its circuit, suppressing the unwanted copies while driving the antenna efficiently.
